recipes.name: Ginger tofu with mushrooms
recipes.description: A stir-fry like this one meets all your veggie needs and is easy to knock up after work
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the onion and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes or until just soft. Add the ginger and tofu. Stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, soy sauce and stir-fry sauce. Stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add the gai lan. Stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until gai lan is just tender. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, place the noodles in a heatproof bowl. Cover with boiling water. Set aside for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through. Using a fork, separate the noodles. Drain. Serve.

recipes.name: Italian pasta salad
instructions: 1. Boil pasta according to package instructions.
2. Whisk dressing ingredients in a large bowl.
3. Add the drained hot pasta to the dressing.
4. Allow the pasta to cool to absorb the dressing.
5. Add the remaining ingredients.
6. Stir to combine.

recipes.name: Chicken fried rice
instructions: 1. In a skillet over medium-high heat, add the oil. Once the skillet is hot, add the chicken thighs. Cover and cook for 5 minutes, flip chicken over and cook for an additional 5 minutes, covered. When done, chicken juices will run clear. Remove chicken from skillet and transfer to cutting board. Cut the chicken into 1/2'' bite size pieces. Set aside for later.

2. In the same skillet you cooked the chicken in, add the onion and carrot. Cook about 5-7 minutes over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until tender. Add peas, corn, and garlic to the skillet and cook for about 2-3 minutes until corn and peas are hot and no longer frozen. Be sure to stir every so often to ensure an even cook. Add the chicken back to the skillet.
3. Turn heat up to high. Add the rice and begin to stir fry for about 3-5 minutes. Be careful not to mush the rice with a spatula or spoon when stir frying.
4. Turn heat to low. Form a whole in the middle of the fried rice and crack in the egg. Begin to scramble until just almost done. Then, gently mix everything together.
5. Remove fried rice from heat and serve immediately. Serve with soy sauce and sriracha (optional). Enjoy!

recipes.name: Lentil pasta, with turkey, beans and cherry tomatoes
instructions: 1.Cook pasta in a large saucepan of salted boiling water following packet directions, adding the beans in the last 2 minutes of cooking.

2.Meanwhile, heat the oil in a deep non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes or until the onion softens. Add the garlic and chili flakes. Cook, stirring, for 1 minute or until aromatic. Add the turkey and cook, using a wooden spoon to break up any lumps, for 5 minutes or until browned.
3.Addtomato, vinegar and 60ml (1 ⁄4 cup) water. Bring to the boil then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Add pasta, beans and spinach. Toss to combine. Top with spoonfuls of ricotta to serve.

recipes.name: Cucumber Sandwich Appetizers
instructions: 1.Mix cream cheese, sour cream, and Italian salad dressing mix in a bowl until well blended.
2.Spread cream cheese mixture atop pumpernickel party bread and top each slice with 2 cucumber slices.

recipes.name: Apple Circles
instructions: 1.Using an apple corer, keeping the apple whole, core the apple straight down. Discarding the bottom and top slices, cut the apple crosswise into 6 slices and spread on a cutting board. Spread the slices with strawberry yogurt and sprinkle with nuts. Serve.

recipes.name: Scrambled egg toast
instructions: 1.Spread a thin layer of softened butter on both sides of the bread. Frythe bread over heat for about 2 minutes on each side, until a goldencrust forms. 2.Remove the bread from the frying pan and add  butter. Add the egg and feta cheese and cook, stirring often, for about 3-4 minutes, until the egg are cooked through. 3.Divide the egg between the bread slices andsprinkle them with freshly chopped dill or parsley.

recipes.name: Pear-spiced oatmeal
instructions: 1. combine oats with milk, heat until dense.
2. stir in ginger. top with pear.
3. sprinkle with cinnamon.
